entities.name: Baylen
entities.description: Legendary rabbitfolk warrior and part-time farmer who leads the defenses of Haymeadow Village with a red-glowing chili-pepper scythe.

entities.name: Three Tree City
entities.description: City where Baylen lived among lizardfolk.

entities.name: Pawpatch Party
entities.description: Group Baylen was invited to join and later left to defend Haymeadow.

entities.name: Calamity Beast
entities.description: Beasts whose disturbances grew and one of which Baylen drove off.

events.summary: Baylen escapes Three Tree City for the rural Haymeadow and is made an elite Pawpatch recruit.
events.quote: Baylen was quickly scouted and made into an elite Pawpatch recruit

events.summary: Baylen channels raw magic into the scythe to drive off a Calamity.
events.quote: Baylen grabbed their trusty scythe and channeled raw magic into it to drive off the Calamity.

events.summary: Baylen leaves the Pawpatch Party to help Haymeadow's residents defend themselves.
events.quote: Baylen refused to leave Haymeadow defenseless

relations.quote: leads the defenses of Haymeadow Village
